2026 Amazon FBA Fees & Break-Even PPC ACoS: Complete Seller Margin Guide

Break down every 2026 Amazon US FBA cost: 8%–17% referral fees, FBA pick-and-pack tiers, inbound placement, monthly storage, and how to calculate your true Break-Even PPC ACoS.

1. The 4 Stacked Costs Inside Every Amazon FBA Sale

Amazon FBA unlocks Prime conversion rates, but sellers who only check the 15% referral fee frequently discover their net margin is near zero once fulfillment and PPC stack up.

Every FBA unit absorbs: (1) Category Referral Fee (typically 15%, 17% Apparel, 8% Electronics), (2) FBA Pick & Pack Fulfillment ($3.22–$7.50+ by weight/size tier), (3) Inbound Placement + Monthly/Q4 Storage ($0.50–$1.50/unit), and (4) Sponsored Products PPC (TACoS).

2. Why Knowing Break-Even ACoS Beats Guessing PPC Bids

Your Break-Even PPC ACoS equals your pre-ad profit margin %. On a $34.99 item with $5.25 referral, $5.60 FBA + storage, and $8.20 landed COGS, you have $15.94 pre-ad margin — meaning your exact Break-Even ACoS is 45.6%. Any keyword converting above 45.6% ACoS loses money on every click.

3. Reconciling Bi-Weekly Amazon Settlements Without Spreadsheet Chaos

Amazon deposits one net lump sum every 14 days covering sales, refunds, FBA fees, storage, and PPC charges. Connecting Link My Books splits each settlement into clean QuickBooks or Xero journal entries automatically.
